name: recurse
description: Discover paid APIs and run private Python tools through Recurse. Inspect schemas and prices, set a spending cap, and retrieve stored results.

interface.longDescription: Use eligible APIs from agent-written Python tools, execute privately with an explicit spending cap, and read durable results and billing. Discover published tools and API schemas through 13 generic MCP operations. Native Tools use requires Recurse SDK 0.2.7 or newer and a Recurse account.
defaultPrompt: Find a Recurse tool for my task and inspect its inputs and price.
Call an inspected Recurse tool within my spending allowance.
Check the stored result and charge for my Recurse call.
